USB connects first when its tunnel is ready. Without USB, DeskInk reconnects to the last successfully paired LAN PC. For the first LAN connection, enable LAN / Wi-Fi on Windows and enter its address while both devices use the same trusted network.
Default port: 9876. Enter the PC’s pairing code on the next screen. A 5 or 6 GHz Wi-Fi connection and a PC connected by Ethernet help reduce delay. Network conditions can still affect latency.
Automatic connection paused · tap Wi-Fi to reconnect
Enter the PC’s IPv4 address and a port from 1 to 65535.
LAN disconnected · tap Wi-Fi to reconnect
Check the PC address, LAN setting, same network and Windows firewall permission.
The network delayed pen input. Disconnected to prevent old strokes arriving late. Reconnect with Wi-Fi or use USB.
Could not read saved PCs. Reopen DeskInk. If this continues, reset its storage in Android Settings.
Could not save this PC. You may need its code on reconnect.

1. Install the APK on your tablet.
2. Settings → About tablet → Software information → tap Build number 7 times.
3. Developer options → USB debugging: on.
4. Connect a USB data cable and allow this PC on the tablet.
5. Run DeskInk-Android.exe on Windows, then enter the PC’s six-digit code here.

Only authorize computers you trust. Turn off USB debugging when you no longer use the USB connection.
